'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[Catatumbo campaign]]
***[[2025 Catatumbo clashes]]
****Local authorities of [[Teorama]], [[Norte de Santander Department|Norte de Santander]], [[Colombia]], find the bodies of thirteen [[FARC dissidents|FARC]] combatants. [https://www.elespectador.com/judicial/urgente-catatumbo-hoy-encuentran-13-cuerpos-sin-vida-en-zona-rural-de-teorama-noticias-hoy/ (''El Espectador'')]
*[[Kivu conflict]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda tensions (2022–present)|Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda tensions]]
**[[M23 offensive (2022–present)|M23 offensive]]
***[[Battle of Goma (2025)|Battle of Goma]]
****[[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels claim to have captured the city of [[Goma]] in [[North Kivu Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. The government says its troops still hold the [[Goma International Airport]] and other key locations, and that [[Rwanda]]n army soldiers are present in Goma. [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese]] and [[Rwanda Defence Force|Rwandan forces]] exchange fire along the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda border|border]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/27/declaration-of-war-m23-rebels-claim-to-have-captured-key-dr-congo-city (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0qwlkydxxko (BBC)] [https://www.dw.com/en/dr-congo-says-rwanda-army-in-goma/a-71422564 (DW)]

'''Business and economy'''
*A global technology stocks selloff on the [[Nasdaq Stock Market]], prompted by the release of the [[China|Chinese]] [[DeepSeek]]-R1 model, leads to record losses in the [[market capitalization]]s of [[artificial intelligence|AI]] and [[computer hardware]] [[List of computer hardware manufacturers|companies]]. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/chinas-deepseek-sets-off-ai-market-rout-2025-01-27/ (Reuters)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''

*Four people are killed by a landslide in [[Mamuju Regency]], [[West Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.antaranews.com/berita/4610634/empat-tewas-akibat-bencana-longsor-di-mamuju (Antara News (in Indonesian)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–India relations]]
**Following the meeting between [[Foreign Secretary (India)|Indian Foreign Secretary]] [[Vikram Misri]] and [[Foreign Minister of China|Chinese Foreign Minister]] [[Wang Yi (politician)|Wang Yi]] in [[Beijing]], [[China]] and [[India]] agree to resume direct air travel between the two countries after a five-year hiatus. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/india-china-agree-resume-air-travel-after-five-years-4899321 (CNA)].

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Interpol Terrorism Watch List]]
**A joint [[INTERPOL]] and [[Afripol|AFRIPOL]] operation including eight [[East Africa]]n nations leads to the arrest of 37 people and the seizure of [[small arms and light weapons|small]] and [[heavy weapon]]s in [[Kenya]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], [[Somalia]], and [[Tanzania]]. '''Politics and elections'''
* [[Second presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[Executive Order 14186]], [[Executive Order 14183]]
***President Trump signs an executive order eliminating "gender radicalism in the military", targeting [[Transgender personnel in the United States military|transgender personnel]] in the [[United States Armed Forces|military]], and another executive order that mandates a process to develop an American [[Iron Dome]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20250128-trump-signs-executive-orders-aimed-at-trans-troops-mandates-american-iron-dome (France 24)]
**[[Second cabinet of Donald Trump]]
***The [[United States Senate]] votes to confirm [[Scott Bessent]] as [[United States Secretary of the Treasury|U.S. Treasury Secretary]], making him the highest rank [[LGBTQ]] official to run the [[United States Treasury|U.S. Treasury]] and the highest-ranking LGBTQ person in the United States. [https://time.com/7210423/scott-bessent-confirmed-trump-treasury-secretary/ (TIME)]
**[[United States]] [[Office of Management and Budget]] acting director Matthew Vaeth orders [[Federal government of the United States|federal government]] agencies to temporarily pause all federal financial assistance programs, with the exception of [[Medicare (United States)|Medicare]] and [[Social Security (United States)|Social Security]], that could be implicated by select [[executive order]]s from [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]].
